title_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in an existing building in Varri Bamit, €115,000
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in an existing building in Varri Bamit. The surface of the apartment is 69.1 m2, located on the top floor of an existing building without an elevator. It is organized in a common living room and kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. The apartment is completely reconstructed as in the photo. The terrace is also covered with a roof. For more information, contact us.
